findings.finding: The per-task effect changes sign across the set: 4 flip(s), spread 10770 percentage points (best +10672.0%, worst -97.6%). UNIVERSAL application is therefore unsupported by this evidence. The mechanism is not uniformly wrong; it is unrouted.
findings.proposed_change: replace universal application with a deterministic pre-task eligibility decision, using signals available BEFORE execution, with an explicit fallback
findings.revalidation: deterministic decision fixtures covering the favourable, unfavourable and unmeasurable shapes

findings.finding: No registered gate was met in either direction. The measured effect is directional at best, and no claim of a decisive advantage is supported by this run.
findings.proposed_change: none — record the null and do not re-describe a directional result as a decisive one
